gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-marcellus-s: Raw and blunt, Capture Smallz stamps big-bodied letters. Marcellus SC, a classic serif, settles in beside it with gentle stroke modulation and a dignified, literary hush, so the two feel like graffiti next to a library plaque.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-serif-: Rough, tactical, big-bodied: that is Capture Smallz at a glance. Noto Serif Hentaigana has open jaws on its curves and small letters nearly capital height, but make the heading small or the body large and that refined tradition starts to crowd the page.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-ovo: Capture Smallz hits with big-bodied lowercase and a raw, tactical swagger, its line weight barely varying at all. Ovo, a serif, answers with a slight charcoal-like pressure shadow and spacious curve terminals, which gives the pair authority.
gen-dafont-college-gf-domine: Domine, a serif, has a breathing space inside every curve and a measured swell from hairline to stem. College supplies the heading with a plain ballpoint-like line, and that smooth, pressure-free weight makes the longer reading below feel refined and dignified.
gen-dafont-college-gf-esteban: College leads with every curve as thick as a straight stem, then Esteban, a classic serif, follows with oversized lowercase and a wide-open e. Dynamic up top, refined below.
gen-dafont-college-gf-faustina: Authoritative from the first word, College draws one constant stroke from top to baseline. Faustina, a classic serif, gets a little more room in its text size, since its pliers-jawed c and tightening curve tops reward that.
gen-dafont-college-gf-halant: College has no hairlines to squint at, just heavy curves and big counters in a tall lowercase. Yet Halant, a serif, adds a friendly, mild contrast and outward-pointing terminals, which gives the pair its traditional authority.
gen-dafont-college-gf-hedvig-letters-ser: Blunt, tall and heavy, College has no calligraphic swelling anywhere. Hedvig Letters Serif, a text serif, does the opposite job, with open-ended curves and a mild letterpress thick-thin variation that rewards close reading.
gen-dafont-college-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa, a classic serif, lets its counters spill into the space around them and makes words look sturdy and large. And College, with diagonals matching its stems, feels like a bolder, blunter sibling beside it.
gen-dafont-college-gf-marcellus-sc: Heavy, round-bellied lowercase marks College, with every curve as thick as its stems. Yet Marcellus SC brings gentle modulation and pulled-back terminals, so the two sit together like a loud voice beside a measured one.
